responsibility: Provides the x86 SM3 intrinsic header for the Chinese SM3 hash acceleration instructions. It conditionally enables `sm3` and defines the vector message-schedule and round helpers `_mm_sm3msg1_epi32`, `_mm_sm3msg2_epi32`, and `_mm_sm3rnds2_epi32`, including the immediate-controlled round form, so front-end code can invoke SM3 hardware support through GCC’s builtin layer.
